name: herramientas-de-oficina
description: Editor de textos tipo Writer con IA integrada.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.install:browser: npm exec --prefix server -- playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVIDOR,EDITOR -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run install:browser && node scripts/setup-env.js
